text:
Alicia V: Quick follow-up to the multi-region residency RFC — we need a concrete fallback surface for tenant writes when the resident region is down. Current options in doc feel high-level. Thoughts?

Mike R: agree, customers are asking for a predictable behavior. we should list modes: hard-block, async-shadow, encrypted-forward. :thinking:

Sara L: prefer async-shadow + opt-in BYOK. if we accept writes outside EU, they should be encrypted with customer KMS and flagged in audit logs. plus consent token in tenant profile.

Jonatan B: okay but async-shadow means we need reconciliation guarantees. what about ordering and session affinity? clients expect recent reads.

Alicia V: proposal: three modes per-tenant: "block" (451), "defer" (queue+notify), "forward-encrypted" (accept encrypted, replicate to resident when back). default = block for regulated tenants.

Mike R: for "defer" we should return a short-lived queue token and 202. sample:

```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Content-Type: application/json
{
 "status":"deferred",
 "queue_id":"q_6f8b",
 "eta_seconds":30,
 "reason":"resident_unavailable"
}
```

Sara L: yes. add header X-Resident-Policy: "eu-only" and X-Consent-Token when BYOK accepted. store the consent token in tenant profile.

Jonatan B: for forward-encrypted we must scope KMS use. if customer manages keys, we can't decrypt in our control plane to route — we just persist blobs and push to resident when available. need proof-of-delivery and audit events.

Mike R: metrics to track: deferred_write_rate, forwarded_encrypted_bytes, reconciliation_lag_p50/p95. also SLA impact: deferred mode adds tail latency for readiness checks.

Alicia V: how do we surface to customers? console toggle + API flag per-tenant. UX: show live residency status and last replication timestamp. :thumbsup:

Jonatan B: edge cases — what if resident region recovers but model weights changed (different model variant)? reconciliation may fail. we need conflict resolution policy: accept resident as source-of-truth, mark conflicting records and emit alerts.

Sara L: +1. also add a safety window: if reconciliation takes >24h, auto-block further non-resident forwards unless explicit override.

infra-bot: deploy-status: canary of "residency-fallback-v1" will go out to staging on 2026-04-02.

Alicia V: next steps: write a small API contract doc for the three modes, add telemetry hooks, and design the reconciliation operator. can someone take API contract?

Mike R: I'll draft the contract. will link a PR by EOD tomorrow. 

Sara L: I'll outline KMS flow and audit events.

Jonatan B: I'll prototype reconciliation operator assumptions (idempotency keys, ordering hints).

Alicia V: thanks — we should capture this as a follow-up RFC. closing thread for now :sparkles:
